name: org_graph_change_unit_kind
description: Change the unit type of a unit Espalia holds, from effective_on (today by default). The new type must be one Espalia supplies, must be able to sit under the unit's parent (or at the top), and every live sub-unit must be able to sit under it, on every day from effective_on, a move dated ahead included. effective_on can't be after today or before the unit's last change of type. It needs the right to change the structure in force where the unit sits: a tenant admin or an Org Graph editor for any, and for a unit's own structure an owner of that unit or a unit above it, or anyone above them in the reporting line.
